name: Electrify
effect: Never Fail. The Damage from the next attack made by the target will be Electric Type. Reduce the duration of Screens on the targets side of the battlefield by 2 Rounds. On a Critical Strike, reduce the duration by 3 Rounds instead.
description: The user hurls an electric projectile to the target, the foe is charged with electricity until it is released by the foe's next attack.
